description: This file defines the 'Tab' class for managing browser tab interactions within the Playwright testing framework, including event handling, state management, navigation, and snapshot capturing.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Represents a browser tab, managing its state, events, and interactions.

methods.name: forPage
methods.description: Retrieves the Tab instance associated with a given Playwright page.

methods.name: modalStates
methods.description: Returns the current modal states of the tab.

methods.name: setModalState
methods.description: Adds a modal state to the tab and emits an event.

methods.name: clearModalState
methods.description: Removes a specific modal state from the tab.

methods.name: modalStatesMarkdown
methods.description: Returns a markdown-formatted description of current modal states.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the stored title of the tab.

methods.name: lastTitle
methods.description: Returns the last known title of the tab.

methods.name: isCurrentTab
methods.description: Checks if this tab is the current active tab.

methods.name: waitForLoadState
methods.description: Waits for the page to reach a specific load state.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the tab to a specified URL.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the tab's current state.

methods.name: refLocator
methods.description: Returns a locator for a referenced element.

methods.name: refLocators
methods.description: Returns locators for multiple referenced elements.

methods.name: waitForTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a specified timeout, considering JavaScript blocking.
